text.p: Second seed Felix Mantilla of Spain bowed out of the Bournemouth International Open on Wednesday, beaten 6-2 2-6 6-4 in the second round by emerging Argentine 18-year-old Mariano Zabaleta.
Zabaleta, who in the last nine months has climbed from 380 in the world rankings to 125, won the opening set of a long baseline duel then broke the Spaniard in the first game of the second set.
Mantilla, ranked 16th in the world, fought back to win nine of the next 10 games to lead 3-0 in the third and world junior champion Zabaleta looked down and out.
But he battled back to win five of the last six games for the best win of his career and a place in the quarter-finals.
"I thought I had lost when I went 3-0 down in the final set," the Argentine said. "But it was only one break and I did not give up. I guess I was pretty lucky."
